## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.
State owned files or components and scope limits.
List dependencies and blocking owner decisions, or write "none".

Acceptance checks:
- [ ] State each acceptance check and link its evidence below.
- [ ] Keep shared code generic and core details in adapters.
- [ ] Do not claim a pass, match or accept without enough evidence.
- [ ] Keep history, validation, evidence and review-record files out of the repository.

## Testing

Give exact commands and pass/fail/skip counts.
State checks not run, missing tools and evidence limits.
For bug fixes, identify the test that fails before the fix.
For dependency advisories, give the date, version, advisory, reachability,
disposition and remaining checks here or in the linked issue.

## Issues

Use `Closes #N` only when all acceptance items are complete.
Otherwise use `Refs #N` and list remaining work and owner decisions.
